description: Dept. of Local Government - Eastern Province - Declared A.  M. M.  Nausad and A. Ananda as Chairman  for the Navithanveli and Sammanthurai P/S
categorisation: This gazette content announces the declaration of elected Chairmen for two Pradeshiya Sabhas (local authorities) following elections. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and contains election results and declarations, which directly falls under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
